phrases.english: 1.O Reliever of worry! O Remover of grief!
2.O Merciful in this world and the next and Compassionate in both!
3.Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
4.relieve my worry, and remove my grief!

phrases.arabic: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا أَحَدُ، يَا صَمَدُ،
phrases.english: 5.O One, O Unique, O Eternal Refuge!
6.O He Who has not begotten, nor has been begotten,
7.and equal to Him is not any one!
8.Preserve me, purify me, and take away my affliction!

phrases.arabic: [وَاقْرَأْ آيَةَ الْكُرسِيّ وَالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ  وَقُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ وَقُلْ:]
phrases.english: 9.HERE YOU SHOULD RECITE THE THRONE VERSE (2:255), THE TWO SURAS OF TAKING REFUGE (113-114), AND UNITY (112). THEN SAY:

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ،
phrases.english: 10.O God, I ask You with the asking of him whose neediness is intense,
11.whose strength is frail, whose sins are many,

phrases.arabic: سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ يَجِدُ لِفَاقَتِهِ مُغِيْثاً،
phrases.english: 12.the asking of one who finds no helper in his neediness,
13.no strengthener in his frailty,
14.no forgiver of his sin other than You,
15.O Possessor of majesty and munificence!

phrases.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ عَمَلاً تُحِبُّ بِهِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ،
phrases.english: 16.I ask of You a work through which You wilt love him who works it

phrases.arabic: وَيَقِيناً تَنْفَعُ بِهِ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَنَ بِهِ
phrases.english: 17.and a certainty by which You wilt profit him who is certain
18.with the truth of certainty concerning the execution of Your command!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
phrases.english: 19.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
20.take my soul while it is firm in sincerity,
21.cut off my need for this world,
22.make my desire for what is with You
23.become a yearning to meet You,
24.and give me true confidence in You!

phrases.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ كِتَاب قَدْ خَلاَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ
phrases.english: 25.I ask of You the good of the writ that has been made and I seek refuge with You
26.from the evil of the writ that has been made.
27.I ask of You the fear of The worshipers,
28.the worship of those humbly fearful of You,
29.the certainty of those who have confidence in You,
30.and the confidence of those who have faith in You.
31.O God, make my desire in my asking
32.like the desire of Your friends in their asking,
33.and my fear like the fear of Your friends!
34.Employ me in Your good pleasure through works

phrases.arabic: عَمَلاً لاَ أَتْرُكُ مَعَهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ دِيْنِكَ
phrases.english: 35.in which I will not leave aside anything of Your religion
36.fearing any of Your creatures!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ هَذِهِ حَاجَتِي، فَأَعْظِمْ فِيهَا رَغْبَتِي،
phrases.english: 37.God, this is my need, so make my desire for it great,

phrases.arabic: وَأَظْهِرْ فِيهَا عُذْرِي، وَلَقِّنِي فِيهَا حُجَّتِي وَعَافِ فِيْهَا جَسَدِيْ.
phrases.english: 38.within it make manifest my excuse, through it instil me with my argument, and by means of it make well my body!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَصْبَحَ لَهُ ثِقَةٌ أَوْ رَجَآءٌ غَيْرُكَ،
phrases.english: 39.O God, some rise in the morning having trust or hope in other than You.
40.I rise in the morning, and You art my trust
41.and my hope in all affairs,
42.so decree for me those which are best in outcome
43.and deliver me from misguiding trials,
44.O Most Merciful of the merciful!

phrases.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّد رُسُولِ اللهِ المُصْطَفَى،
phrases.english: 45.And God bless our chief, Muhammad the Messenger of God, the chosen,
46.and his Household, the pure!
